P1.1.text: ASTEC | Aggregates, Asphalt, Concrete & Road Equipment

P1.2.text: Equipment for aggregates processing, asphalt and concrete production, road construction, industrial heating and forestry applications.

P1.3.text: We provide the equipment, expertise, and innovation you need to stay ahead and succeed in a competitive world.

P1.6.text: Your Industry. Our Solutions. Explore Now.

P1.7.text: Unmatched Strength from Rock to Road ®

P1.8.text: At Astec, we design and build the infrastructure that connects the world, but it’s the connections with people that truly move us forward. Born from innovation and a passion for customer success, we unite as one company to simplify how you do business with us and to strengthen partnerships across the industries we serve. From concept to completion, our solutions are engineered to perform reliably today and be ready for whatever tomorrow brings.

P1.9.text: Astec brings together 16 trusted brands, each with deep industry expertise, to deliver comprehensive solutions across the infrastructure, construction, and materials sectors.

P1.10.text: Astec operates in multiple countries worldwide, providing global reach with local support to deliver consistent, high-quality solutions wherever customers do business.

P1.24.text: With over 1 million square feet of parts storage, Astec ensures the parts you need are always on hand—backed by expert support available 24/7.

P1.25.text: Find authorized dealers and distributors near you to ensure access to genuine Astec products, expert guidance, and dependable support.

P1.26.text: Downtime directly impacts your bottom line, and our expert service team delivers fast, accurate support to keep your operation running smoothly and at peak efficiency.

P1.28.text: With expert-led, year-round training, Astec confidently empowers your team to boost performance, reduce downtime, and maximize equipment value.

P1.29.text: Astec Industries is a globally trusted leader in infrastructure, aggregates, and mining equipment—offering over 100 innovative, state‑of‑the‑art solutions built on decades of engineering excellence. With a relentless focus on operational excellence, aftermarket strength, and strategic growth, Astec equips customers worldwide to build better and operate more profitably.
